name: Fox - Ammo Duplicator
teaser: Duplicate your ammo after a run to not lose anything
description_html:
Duplicate your ammo after each run

Wanted to have a way that I could duplicate my ammo!
Pretty much a cheat to have infinite high level ammo… but what you do with it is up to you!

Ideally, this is put towards the bottom of the load list, or at least lower than whatever you’re trying to duplicate (hint hint, might work for other *stackable* items)

check the config file for settings!!!!!!!!!!!!!
LABEL NEEDS TO BE THE SAME AS THE TAG FOR YOUR CONTAINER!!!
COUNT REFERS TO THE NUMBER OF AMMO TO DUPLICATE!!!

ONLY THE TOP ROW WILL BE DUPLICATED LIKE THE PICTURE SHOWN

ANYTHING IN THE SECOND ROW WILL BE OVERWRITTEN

technically, if you do every other row, it should also work seen in 3rd picture, but im not responsible if it breaks for you!
